acceptedAnswer.text: GoMyTruck is a full-stack digital freight marketplace built by Parther Technologies for intra-city and inter-city commercial logistics in West Bengal, India. It supports instant dispatch and private bidding, with real-time GPS tracking, four-wallet payment infrastructure, and government compliance integrations.

mainEntity.name: What technology stack does GoMyTruck use?

acceptedAnswer.text: GoMyTruck uses Node.js + TypeScript + Express v5 on the backend, PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM, Flutter for three mobile apps, React + Vite for the admin panel, Socket.io for real-time, BullMQ for job queues, Razorpay for payments, RazorpayX for automated payouts, and AWS S3 for storage.

mainEntity.name: How does GoMyTruck handle driver payments?

acceptedAnswer.text: GoMyTruck uses a float-based driver wallet model. For online trips, net earnings are credited immediately. For cash trips, the platform commission is debited from the driver's wallet (which can go negative). Withdrawals are automated via RazorpayX with IMPS for amounts under 2 lakh and RTGS for larger amounts.
